nodes.title: SG-6.4.3 · Wire approve, retry and reject handlers into AdminApp's ExecutionPanel
nodes.body:
Context: ExecutionPanel already accepts onApprove, onRetry, onReject and actionError props. The client already exports approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution. AdminApp renders ExecutionPanel without any handlers, so the buttons never appear. Desired behavior: each handler calls the matching client function with the admin token and execution id, reloads Round, contributions and execution afterwards, and shows an error message on failure. Why: the admin can then act on executions from the console.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the admin clicks Approve or Reject, then the matching client endpoint is called with the id and the Bearer token, and the data reloads
- Given a FAILED execution, when the admin clicks Retry, then the retry endpoint is called and the data reloads
- Given an action endpoint answers an error, when the admin clicks the button, then an error message is shown in the Execution region


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx handlers and error state
- Out of scope: Backend changes, including a reject route
- Out of scope: Changes to ExecutionPanel or api/client.ts
- Preserve: Existing round open/close controls
- Preserve: 401 returns to the token gate
- Preserve: Existing admin tests


## Technical constraints
- UI only; reuse approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution from api/client.ts
- Reload through the existing reloads counter


## Definition of done
- All requirements, units and evidence complete


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · AdminApp passes approve, retry and reject handlers that call the client and reload
nodes.body:
AdminApp currently renders ExecutionPanel with only execution and contributionCount. It must pass onApprove, onRetry and onReject. Each calls approveExecution, retryExecution or rejectExecution with the admin token and the execution id, then increments the reloads counter so the Round, contributions and execution are fetched again.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve is sent and the data is fetched again
- Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/retry is sent and the data is fetched again
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject is sent and the data is fetched again


## Scope
- In scope: AdminApp.tsx execution handlers
- Out of scope: Backend
- Out of scope: ExecutionPanel markup
- Preserve: runRoundAction behavior


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the reloads counter


## Definition of done
- Handlers wired and verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · AdminApp shows an error message when an execution action fails
nodes.body:
When an execution action rejects, AdminApp stores the message in an actionError state and passes it as the actionError prop to ExecutionPanel, which renders it with role alert. A 401 still returns to the token gate. A later successful action clears the message.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the approve endpoint answers 500, when Approve is clicked, then the Execution region shows an alert containing the error message
- Given an action endpoint answers 401, when a button is clicked, then the token gate is shown with 'Invalid token'
- Given a previous action failed, when a later action succeeds, then the action error is no longer shown


## Scope
- In scope: actionError state in AdminApp.tsx
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: handleError 401 behavior
- Preserve: top-level error paragraph for load failures


## Technical constraints
- Use the existing actionError prop of ExecutionPanel


## Definition of done
- Errors shown and verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None
